# The approved public surface: every exported package-level identifier of the
# governed packages (goav root plus the near-frozen vocabulary packages codes,
# lifecycle, plan, snapshot), one per line, sorted. api_surface_pin_test.go
# fails when the packages export a symbol this list does not approve, and when
# the list approves a symbol that no longer exists. Exporting a symbol is a
# deliberate act: add it here in sorted position and say why in the commit.
# See docs/API_SURFACE.md for the tiering (grammar / seam / expert).
